name: io.github.varaprasadreddy9676/huly-mcp
description: MCP server for Huly — manage projects, issues, milestones, components, and documents in your Huly workspace via natural language. Supports Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Continue, and Zed.

environment_variables.name: HULY_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Your Huly workspace token — get from huly.app DevTools → Application → Local Storage → token

environment_variables.name: HULY_WORKSPACE
environment_variables.description: Your Huly workspace slug (the part after huly.app/ in your URL)

environment_variables.name: HULY_FRONT_URL
environment_variables.description: Optional — set to https://front.huly.app to enable reading document content
